name: Classic OTP Voice Phishing (Bank Impersonation)
description: Attacker calls victim posing as ATAF fraud department official. Informs victim that an unauthorized international debit of ₹12,500 is pending. Pretext convinces victim to recite the SMS OTP to 'cancel the fraudulent charge', while attacker actually executes a transfer to a mule account.

attacker_profile.pretext: ATAF Bank Security Alert: Urgent verification required to reverse unauthorized charge.
attacker_profile.victim_psychological_state: Panicked and eager to prevent account loss

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: FAILED: Victim willingly provides OTP; baseline system authorizes fraudulent transfer.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Static 3FA displays recipient name 'Reversal Clearing Escrow' and prompts PIN.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: AI detects new beneficiary + 3x volume deviation; warning banner & parameter lock expose mule.

name: New Beneficiary + Large Emergency Transfer (Family Impersonation)
description: Attacker compromises a WhatsApp contact and contacts the victim posing as their nephew who was involved in an urgent road accident. Demands ₹48,000 immediate hospital deposit to a newly registered third-party UPI/bank account.

attacker_profile.mitre_attack_technique: T1657 - Financial Theft via Social Engineering Pretexting
attacker_profile.pretext: Emergency Medical Assistance: Critical surgery deposit required immediately.

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: FAILED: Victim enters password and OTP; transfer executes instantly to mule account.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Mandates additional confirmation, friction forces victim to review account.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: AI flags 13.7x volume deviation + new beneficiary (R >= 0.70); anti-coercion prompt prevents transfer.

name: Remote Access Tool Takeover (New Device + Large Transfer)
description: Victim receives a message about pending 5G SIM/KYC deactivation. Attacker instructs victim to install AnyDesk/TeamViewer to 'assist with configuration'. While remote session is active, attacker initiates a ₹65,000 transfer from a virtual browser session and watches SMS notifications for OTP.

attacker_profile.mitre_attack_technique: T1219 - Remote Access Software & T1539 - Session Stealing
attacker_profile.pretext: Mandatory Telecom KYC Verification to prevent immediate number suspension.
attacker_profile.victim_psychological_state: Passive / Believes technician is handling routine maintenance

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: FAILED: Attacker reads OTP off victim's mirrored screen; full account drained.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Requires secret PIN not known to attacker and explicit user affirmations.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Critical AI score triggers PSD2 Art. 97 parameter lock; explicit anti-remote-access clause blocks authorization.

name: Off-Hours Coercion ('Digital Arrest' Extortion)
description: Attacker calls at 02:45 AM impersonating cyber police / central enforcement agency. Accuses victim of involvement in money laundering. Under threat of immediate house raid, victim is coerced into transferring ₹35,000 'security bail deposit' to a government-sounding account.

attacker_profile.mitre_attack_technique: T1657 - Extortion & Coercion via Law Enforcement Impersonation
attacker_profile.pretext: Digital Arrest Warrant: Immediate verification deposit required before morning court order.
attacker_profile.delivery_channel: Video Call with fake police backdrop

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: FAILED: Coerced victim inputs OTP at 2 AM; money transferred to fraudster.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Factor 3 anti-coercion confirmation requires conscious affirmative check.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Night-hours flag (02:00) + new beneficiary + 7.7x amount triggers HIGH risk tier; coercive prompt aborted.

name: Extreme Volume Deviation (Fake Investment / Ponzi Yield)
description: Victim joined a fraudulent Telegram crypto trading community promising 400% weekly returns. Convinced by fabricated profit screenshots to transfer ₹90,000 (victim's regular median transfer is ₹4,000, representing a 22.5x volume deviation).

attacker_profile.mitre_attack_technique: T1657 - Financial Fraud via Investment Scam
attacker_profile.pretext: Institutional Crypto Arbitrage: High-yield guaranteed deposit allocation.
attacker_profile.victim_psychological_state: Greed, fear of missing out (FOMO), high excitement

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: FAILED: 2FA allows extreme volume drain with zero anomaly friction.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Static 3FA forces confirmation and PIN check.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: AI model detects extreme tabular amount anomaly (R >= 0.70); strong step-up parameter lock stops drain.

name: Compound Multi-Indicator Attack (Advanced Account Takeover)
description: Attacker acquires leaked credentials and performs an automated burst session: initiates 3 consecutive rapid transfers, adds an offshore mule, and transfers ₹75,000 at 03:15 AM while flooding victim's phone with spam to distract them.

attacker_profile.mitre_attack_technique: T1110 - Brute Force / Credential Stuffing & T1499 - Denial of Service Spam
attacker_profile.pretext: Automated account liquidation via compromised credentials during distraction window.

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: FAILED: If OTP is intercepted or phished, System 1 authorizes entire transfer.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Attacker lacks victim's offline Transaction Security PIN.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: PREVENTED: Compound score R=0.95 (velocity + new beneficiary + off-hours + amount); HMAC parameter seal and PIN defeat attack.

name: Benign Routine Grocery Transfer (Control Baseline)
description: Legitimate user transferring ₹650 for weekly vegetables and groceries to their regular local vendor at 2:30 PM. Established recipient, typical volume, daytime execution.

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: BENIGN AUTHORIZED: Password + OTP approves routine payment in 2 steps.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: USABILITY BURDEN: Forces high friction (Factor 3 PIN + checkboxes) for trivial ₹650 purchase.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: OPTIMAL ADAPTIVE UX: Risk R < 0.30 (LOW); executes immediately with 2FA and zero unnecessary friction.

name: Benign Monthly Rent Payment (Control Baseline)
description: Legitimate user transferring ₹15,000 monthly apartment rent to their established landlord on the 1st of the month at 11:30 AM.

system_1.expected_defense_outcome: BENIGN AUTHORIZED: Standard 2FA completes rent payment.

system_2.expected_defense_outcome: USABILITY BURDEN: Enforces redundant 3FA checks on trusted landlord.

system_3.expected_defense_outcome: OPTIMAL ADAPTIVE UX: R < 0.30 (LOW); completes seamlessly without false positive alarm.
